name: Blitzkrieg
description: Automatic practice progression tracker for GD

ignore-practice-mode.name: Ignore Practice Mode
ignore-practice-mode.description: Do not track runs or update progression while practicing in Practice Mode.

enable-speedhack-detection.name: Enable Speedhack Detection
enable-speedhack-detection.description: Detects speed manipulation and prevents affected runs from being counted.

expand-progress-by-default.name: Auto-expand progress details
expand-progress-by-default.description: Automatically expand progress details in the stage browser.

disable-progress-expansion-animation.name: Disable expansion animation
disable-progress-expansion-animation.description: Disable the animation used when progress statistics expand.

replace-practice-bar-with-blitzkrieg.name: Blitzkrieg instead of practice bar
replace-practice-bar-with-blitzkrieg.description: Replace Geometry Dash's practice bar with the Blitzkrieg progression bar.

practice-bar-divisions-color.name: Practice stage divider color
practice-bar-divisions-color.description: Color of the stage division markers in the progression bar.

practice-bar-divisions-transparency.name: Stage divider opacity
practice-bar-divisions-transparency.description: Opacity of stage division markers in the Blitzkrieg progression bar.

enable-streamer-mode.name: Enable streamer mode
enable-streamer-mode.description: Hide profile names by showing only their first letter in the interface.

disable-run-notifications.name: Disable run notifications
disable-run-notifications.description: Do not show notifications when a run is recorded.

disable-run-notification-sound.name: Disable run notification sound
disable-run-notification-sound.description: Keep run notifications visible but mute their sound.

ignore-built-in-game-sfx.name: Ignore the game's built-in SFX
ignore-built-in-game-sfx.description: Mute Geometry Dash's built-in sound effects while Blitzkrieg SFX are active.

sfx-volume.name: SFX volume
sfx-volume.description: Set the volume of Blitzkrieg progress and stage sounds.

sfx-use-custom-sounds.name: Use custom SFX
sfx-use-custom-sounds.description: Use custom sounds selected below for progress and stage completions.

sfx-progress-path.name: Progress pass SFX
sfx-progress-path.description: Custom sound played when a run completes a progression range.

sfx-stage-path.name: Stage pass SFX
sfx-stage-path.description: Custom sound played when a training stage is completed.
